text:
sasha_rm: FYI RC-2026.03 got blocked during promote. deploy-bot flagged failed jobs and refused to promote to canary :frowning:
deploy-bot: [automated] promote request failed for rc-2026.03 -> canary. Blocking reasons: ci:orchestrator-integ FAILED (flake), artifact-publish ERROR (checksum mismatch).
anita_eng: Seeing the integ cluster timeouts plus a few auth errors when pushing artifacts to s3. Logs show `PUT /upload -> 500` then later checksums don't line up.
matt_sre: I grabbed the artifact from the registry and ran `sha256` locally — mismatch. Also saw bazel-remote returning 200 with truncated content on one collector node.
jen_devex: Any recent infra changes that could explain truncated blobs? We didn't touch s3 proxy but we did roll out a cache indexer change yesterday.
sam_platform: Confirmed: cache-indexer v2 rolled at 03:20 UTC yesterday. We're seeing a pattern where the indexer serves stale size metadata while object upload eventually completes, causing the client to read shorter bytes than expected.
anita_eng: Repro steps I ran:
```
# reproduce push
./ci/artifact-publish.sh rc-2026.03
# got HTTP 200 but digest differs
sha256sum dist/rc-2026.03.tar.gz
# -> a1b2c3...
# remote reports a2b3c4...
```
matt_sre: Short term we can purge the remote cache bucket entries for the last 6 hours and force reupload. That will impact throughput for a bit though.
sasha_rm: We need a decision: hold the release and roll back the indexer change, or pin the RC to the previous artifact that validated and accept a delayed canary?
jen_devex: Pinning artifact version is fastest: revert the promotion to canary and re-run publish to use artifact built on last-green commit (sha: 9f8e7d). That avoids touching infra.
anita_eng: Problem: the failing integ tests are flaky on tip-of-main too. If we promote the old artifact, the canary might still hit integ flake unrelated to artifact issue. Need to isolate.
matt_sre: I propose a two-step: 1) rollback cache-indexer -> v1 (infra change) to stop new corruptions, 2) pin RC to 9f8e7d and re-run CI publish against the pinned commit into a fresh bucket. If publish succeeds, we can resume canary within the change window.
deploy-bot: [automated] promotion reverted for rc-2026.03. Active hold placed. Escalation: #eng-oncall notified.
sasha_rm: Agree with matt. Please open rollback PR for indexer and a pin PR for release manager to sign off. Also update release notes to say: "Release delayed due to artifact integrity and integration test flakiness; rolling back cache indexer and republishing." Keep customers updated.
jen_devex: I'll open the PRs and add a short rollback playbook. tagging @matt_sre for ops runbook steps.
sam_platform: Rolling back indexer now — starting canary rollback at 1719990000.
ci-bot: [automated] re-run requested: publish-job(rc-2026.03, commit=9f8e7d). Queued.
anita_eng: Re-run logs look cleaner so far — upload finished with 201 and checksum matches.
matt_sre: Good. Purging affected cache entries completed. Monitoring for 30m.
sasha_rm: OK hold lifted for canary once SLOs stable 30m. Notify support to delay release announcements by 1h and add note to release notes draft.
jen_devex: Draft updated: "Auto-release paused; revalidation underway after infra rollback to address artifact mismatch and intermittent integration failures." Sharing in #release-notes for signoff.
sam_platform: All done on rollback. Leaving watch for 1h. If anything else pops, we abort canary.
anita_eng: Thanks team — will keep this thread updated if we see any more checksum anomalies.
matt_sre: Adding a postmortem ticket: INFRA-312 to track root cause and add extra validation on upload path.
sasha_rm: Closing action items: PRs opened (rollback + pin), canary pending, support notified. Reopen thread if we need to abort. :thumbsup:
